summary: Onboarding tour + tooltip kit + final frontend QA. Automated gates green. Pixel screenshots require a live browser session (see limitation).

spotlight-tour: reduced-motion sets data-reduced and steps instantly
tour-kit: first-run auto-runs once then never automatically
on-demand re-trigger via Show me around
ExplainTip tooltip a11y: role=tooltip on hover+focus, aria-describedby, Escape/blur dismiss

tour.focusManagement: focus moves into coachmark on open + each step; restored on close
tour.srAnnouncement: role=status aria-live polite: 'Step X of N: <title>'
tour.reducedMotion: no spotlight animation, instant steps when app motion OFF or prefers-reduced-motion

responsiveAudit.method: static CSS review (no browser available in this environment)

newKitOverflowGuards: coachmark width: min(440px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-width: calc(100vw - 32px)
help button text hidden < 520px (icon-only) to avoid crowding
findings.notes: Kit elements are fixed/absolute overlays sized with viewport-relative caps, so they do not introduce horizontal overflow at any width.

screenshots.reason: No headless browser (Playwright/Puppeteer) is installed and installing one requires network egress, which is out of scope for this frontend-only milestone.
screenshots.howToCapture: Run `npm run dev`, then load each of the 12 routes at 1440/820/390px and 200% zoom in both themes and export PNGs into this directory.
